limitations: Assistant visual inspection, not human approval; the separate assistant received expected-change context before inspection and was not blinded.
Screenshots establish captured visible states only. Interaction behavior, keyboard/focus, semantics, accessibility conformance, native/OEM phones and conversion outcomes are outside this review.
The43-capture suite uses default Turkish Chromium states at its committed viewports; other-engine/locale/text-enlargement tests are separate evidence and are not inferred from this packet.

Full-page bodies are sampled using three550px registered bands plus final1000px footers. Crop edges are not page clipping, and diagnostic registration offsets do not change CI thresholds or prove every product is present.
All actual CI failures remain genuine comparison failures. The not-confirmed verdict concerns only candidate unexpected visible harm.
Five of98 corresponding PNG pairs differ between the two attempts; this evidence does not claim identical raw captures or all identical metrics.

The wide derived desktop-hero PNG became truncated after creation/hash and was excluded from the derived manifest. Separate-column JPEG copies were inspected; all raw archive entries are reverified separately. No cause is assigned to the derived-file truncation.
The H3 job failed at missing current-content reviewed-change verification and skipped downstream UI/UX checks. This record is not a claim that the whole H3 visual job passed.
